questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech. 

The gardener said, “Shall I plant roses in this flower bed?”

options.text: The gardener asked that if he should plant roses in this flower bed.
The gardener asked if I shall plant roses in this flower bed.
The gardener asked if he should plant roses in that flower bed.
The gardener asked if I should plant roses in that flower bed.

questions.solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is **The gardener asked if he should plant roses in that flower bed. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Direct speech** quotes the exact words spoken. While writing a direct speech, we must place the words spoken in **quotation marks. **

 **Example**: She said, "I am ready."

 
• **Indirect speech** or Reported speech is used to report the words spoken by someone in the past. 

 **Example**: She said she was ready. 

 
• **Interrogative sentences are those that ask a question. When we change an interrogative sentence from direct to indirect speech, we do the following: **
 
• **If the interrogative sentence begins with an auxiliary verb, we use 'if' or 'whether' in the reported speech.**

 **Example**: She asked, "Are you sick?" - She asked if I was sick.

 
• We **change the reporting verb** (eg. said) to asked, questioned, queried, demanded of, and enquired of in the reported speech.

 **Example:** He said to her, "What do you want?" - He asked her what she wanted.

 
• In the given sentence reporting speech is in the past tense as **'said'** is given and we have to replace** 'said'** with** 'asked'** and in the place of **'shall'** we have to use **'should'** to change the sentence into reported speech.
 
• Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 

**The direct speech is**: ***The gardener asked if he should plant roses in that flower bed*. **

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Switch off the lights before you leave.

options.text: The lights should switch off before you leave.
The lights should be switching off before you leave.
Let the lights be switch off before you leave.
Let the lights be switched off before you leave.

questions.solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is** Let the lights be switched off before you leave. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an** imperative sentence** and in the **present indefinite tense.**
 
• In **Present Indefinite** Tense always have to **use the present form of the main verb**.
 
• **The rule for changing the present indefinite tense into Active or Passive voice:**

** ♦ Follow the structure ‘Let + subject + be + III' form of the verb.__**

 ♦**You can also start the Passive with ‘You are ordered/advised/requested (according to the sense of the sentence) + to followed by the complete sentence in the Active Voice. (and it is the easiest way, though informal.**)

 ♦.**In case, the sentence starts with ‘Please/Kindly' remove it and start the Passive Voice with ‘You are requested to' followed by the sentence.**

 
• **Example**: *Speak the truth* (Active voice)

 *Let the truth be spoken*. (Passive Voice)

 
• **Corrected sentence: *Let the lights be switched off before you leave.***

 

​Hence, **option 4** is the right answer.

• The above statement states that **free space** should be the appropriate answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• If we use** traffic** in the sentence then it will be - One major advantage of the complete lockdown for animals was more traffic, which does not make any sense.
 
• If we use **pollution** in the sentence then it will be - One major advantage of the complete lockdown for animals was more pollution, which does not make any sense.
 
• If we use **human control** in the sentence then it will be - One major advantage of the complete lockdown for animals was more human control, which does not make any sense.

 

Hence, the correct sentence is **One major advantage of the complete lockdown for animals was more free space.**

questions.question: _______ is NOT responsible for the increase in environmental pollution.
questions.solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is **Kitchen waste from homes.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the passage there is no mention of waste materials from kitchen and homes that causes environmental pollution.
 
• **Kitchen waste from homes** are also known as **Biodegradable waste**.
 
• **Biodegradable waste** means typically originating from plant or animal sources, which may be degraded by other living organisms.

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****Disposable plastic** such as plastic straws, bags, coffee stirrers, food packaging, and soda and water bottles, never break down completely. Instead, they degrade and become microplastics and continue to pollute the environment.
 
• **Chemical waste from hospitals** is an inadequate management of hospital waste, that have toxic, infectious and chemical wastes, is a risk factor for humans and environment.
 
• **Increased medicine consumption** also known as pharmaceutical pollution is especially concerning. Aquatic life is swimming in a cocktail of antidepressants, amphetamines, birth control, and antihistamines. And research shows that these compounds alter organisms and put ecosystems, drinking water, and human health at risk.

 

Hence the correct sentence is - **Kitchen waste from homes is NOT responsible for the increase in environmental pollution.**
